def exact_top(q, m=10):
    s = X @ q
    idx = np.argpartition(-s, m)[:m]
    return idx[np.argsort(-s[idx])]

# X: 50,000 unit vectors x 64 dims
# one query = 50,000 dot products
caption: Cost grows linearly with the number of vectors.

km = KMeans(n_clusters=100, n_init=1,
            random_state=0).fit(X)
lists = [np.where(km.labels_ == c)[0]
         for c in range(100)]

# k-means groups vectors into 100 cells
# lists[c] = ids of vectors in cell c
caption: Cluster once; search only nearby cells later.

eyebrow: Approximate search: probe a few cells
code:
def approx_top(q, m=10, nprobe=5):
    sims = km.cluster_centers_ @ q
    near = np.argsort(-sims)[:nprobe]
    cand = np.concatenate(
        [lists[c] for c in near])
    s = X[cand] @ q
    top = np.argsort(-s)[:m]
    return cand[top]
caption: nprobe = how many cells to search.
